questiontext.text: What is the meaning of "Honesty" in Civic Education?

generalfeedback.text: Honesty is the virtue of truthfulness, integrity, and uprightness in speech and behavior.

answer.text: The moral quality of being truthful, sincere, upright, and free from deceit

feedback.text: Correct! Honesty is the virtue of truthfulness, integrity, and uprightness in speech and behavior.

answer.text: The ability to tell persuasive lies without getting caught

feedback.text: Incorrect. Honesty is the virtue of truthfulness, integrity, and uprightness in speech and behavior.

answer.text: Possessing a large bank balance and owning luxury houses

feedback.text: Incorrect. Honesty is the virtue of truthfulness, integrity, and uprightness in speech and behavior.

answer.text: Using physical strength to overpower classmates in arguments

feedback.text: Incorrect. Honesty is the virtue of truthfulness, integrity, and uprightness in speech and behavior.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are primary attributes of an honest individual? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Truthfulness, reliability, and integrity define honesty; cheating is the direct opposite.

questiontext.text: Identify two key societal benefits of cultivating a culture of honesty: (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: Honesty reduces corruption and fosters institutional trust. It does not replace productive work or the justice system.

questiontext.text: Match each moral concept to its correct definition:

generalfeedback.text: Truthfulness is stating facts; Integrity is moral consistency; Transparency is openness; Accountability is answering for actions.
